999008199.text:
九偉人図、あれには描き手の生き様が込められている。
あれを欲するのなら、それ相応の生き様を見せてみろ！

localizations.en: The Portrait of the Nine captures the very soul of its creator. If you want it, you'll have to prove your own mettle!
King of Bestira

999008199.text:
これは……獣人限定、ベスティラ武道会の告知？
全員一斉参加、最後まで残った者が勝利……

localizations.en: This is... an announcement for the Bestira Martial Arts Tournament? Beastkin only, all participants enter at once, last one standing wins...
Alvina

999008199.text:
優勝者にはベスティラ王が可能な範囲で
願いを１つ叶えてくれる……これに参加しろと？

localizations.en: And the winner gets one wish granted by the king, within reason... He wants us to enter?
Geron

999008199.text:
そうだ。これに勝ち残り、「九偉人図」を望むがいい。
見たところお前も腕に覚えがあるのだろう？

localizations.en: That's right. Win the tournament and claim the Portrait of the Nine as your prize. You look like you know how to handle yourself, yes?
King of Bestira

999008199.text:
欲しいものがあるのならば、
お前の生き様で、掴み取ってみせるがいい！

localizations.en: If you want something, then prove it with everything you've got!
King of Bestira

999008199.text:
……武道会に出てくれるのはすっごく助かる。
でもあんなことがあったんだし、無理しちゃダメだよ？

localizations.en: ...It's a huge help that you're willing to fight for us. But after everything that happened, don't push yourself too hard, okay?
Resna

999008199.text:
だいじょーぶ、アイスなんかへっちゃらだから。
それに、ジェロンとティム君だって出るもんね！

localizations.en: I'll be fine! A little ice is nothing. Besides, Geron and Tim are entering too!
Izana

999008199.text:
僕は生まれつきの獣人じゃないけど……
皆さんのために頑張ります！

localizations.en: I wasn't born a beastkin, but... I'll give it everything I have for everyone!
Tim

999008199.text:
ああ、俺も全力を尽くそう。
ティムには傷一つ付けさせん

localizations.en: As will I. And I won't let Tim take so much as a scratch.
Geron

999008199.text:
改めてだけど、細かい決まりとかはないんだよね？
なんでもありのガチンコ対決？

localizations.en: Just to confirm—there aren't any specific restrictions, right? It's a full-on free-for-all?
Alvina

999008199.text:
実際に戦うのが獣人であること以外、
特に制限はないみたいです

localizations.en: Other than the fighters needing to be beastkin, there don't seem to be any other rules.
Tim

999008199.text: 武器や道具の持ち込みも問題ないようだな

localizations.en: Bringing in weapons and tools is apparently fair game too.
Geron

999008199.text:
道具となると……レスナ、
やっぱりアタシたちの出番ってことだね！

localizations.en: Tools, huh... Resna, sounds like it's our time to shine!
Alvina

999008199.text: うん！　錬金術士として、全力でみんなを支援しよう！

localizations.en: Right! Let's use every bit of our alchemy to back everyone up!
Resna

999008199.text:
本番で役立つ道具……傷薬や、力の出る携帯食料、
あとは爆弾とか……ありったけを用意しよう！

localizations.en: Things we can use in the fight... healing salves, stamina rations, bombs... let's put together everything we've got!
Resna

999008199.text:
なら、俺もアトリエに戻るべきだな。
道具の準備が勝敗を左右しそうだ

localizations.en: Then I should head back to the atelier as well. Our preparation could make or break this.
Geron

999008199.text:
素材も集めてこなきゃね！
砂漠の国ならではの食材、探してみようかな

localizations.en: We'll need to gather materials too! Maybe I can track down some ingredients unique to a desert country.
Izana

999008199.text:
武道会本番まで時間がない……
急いで調合にかかろう！

localizations.en: We don't have much time before the tournament... let's get to synthesizing, fast!
Resna
